hero.title: Find a musician for now or later
hero.subtitle: Add concert details, match a musician and get the music going.
hero.iAmMusicianDesc: Looking for gigs in my area

features.title: Everything you need
features.subtitle: Built for the live music industry.
features.liveMapDesc: See available musicians nearby. Musicians appear on the map only when they enable availability.
features.aiMatchingDesc: Our AI analyzes genre, instruments, distance and style to find the best musicians.
features.messagesDesc: Chat directly with musicians or venues. Arrange details and confirm bookings.
features.simplePricingDesc: Musicians $1.99/mo, venues $3.99/mo. No hidden fees, no commission.
features.notificationsDesc: Get instant notifications about matched gigs or acceptances.
features.privacyDesc: Location shared only when you're actively available. Full GDPR compliance.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: From sign-up to your first gig in minutes.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Choose your role — musician or venue. 7-day trial, no credit card required.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Add genres, instruments, venue atmosphere and set your location in one click.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Claude AI analyses style, budget and atmosphere compatibility. You only see matches ≥ 50%.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Approve a proposal — a real-time chat opens. Agree on details and play.
howItWorks.featuresSubtitle: One product instead of spreadsheets, phone calls and classifieds.
howItWorks.feat1Desc: Musicians and gigs visible on Google Maps in your area with the AI score on the pin.
howItWorks.feat2Desc: Claude AI rates style, budget and atmosphere compatibility. Severe mismatches are excluded.
howItWorks.feat3Desc: Each approved proposal opens a direct chat. Parallel conversations with multiple parties.
howItWorks.feat4Desc: 7 days free. Musician: €1.99/mo. Venue: €3.99/mo. Cancel anytime.

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.subtitle: 7 days free. No commission, no hidden fees.
pricing.musicianDesc: For soloists and bands looking for gigs
pricing.venueDesc: For clubs, bars, restaurants and hotels
